reasons.text: Duplicate check found another claim (7730066a-e05d-5127-a78f-903703546243) sharing the same payout destination. Under the program policy, any shared payout account must be sent to a person for review, which takes precedence over the other checks.

The other checks would otherwise pass: the label is legible and shows PA-10 (a recalled model), the date code 2126 is in range, the purchase at Sweetwater Sound on 2023-08-15 is inside the sale window and at a listed retailer, and no destruction photo is required for this remedy.
